cards.headline: PM Modi departs for Manila to attend ASEAN and East Asia Summits
cards.body: Prime Minister Narendra Modi left for Manila, Philippines, at the invitation of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., to attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit on November 17, 2026. In his departure statement, he said ties with ASEAN are at the heart of India's Act East Policy and central to the MAHASAGAR vision, spanning trade, connectivity, maritime security and technology.
cards.why_it_matters: The Act East Policy guides India's engagement with Southeast Asia, and ASEAN is a key partner for trade, connectivity and security in the Indo-Pacific.
cards.key_fact: 23rd ASEAN-India Summit held in Manila on November 17, 2026

quiz.q: Which edition of the ASEAN-India Summit is PM Modi attending in Manila?
quiz.explain: The article states Modi is attending the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit.

cards.headline: PM Modi heads to Manila for ASEAN summits; Quad meeting planned
cards.body: PM Narendra Modi began a visit to Manila on November 16, 2026, to attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit on November 17 at the invitation of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. He said India-ASEAN ties are at the heart of the Act East Policy. A Quad leaders' meeting is also scheduled on the sidelines, the first in two years.
cards.why_it_matters: The Quad and ASEAN summits shape India's diplomacy on Indo-Pacific security, trade and connectivity, which affect regional stability and economic ties.
cards.key_fact: Last Quad leaders' meeting was held in September 2024 in Delaware

quiz.q: Where was the previous Quad leaders' meeting held before the Manila one?
quiz.explain: The article says the last Quad leaders' meeting was chaired by then U.S. President Joe Biden in Delaware on September 21, 2024.

cards.headline: India and U.S. agree on preferential market access for Indian goods
cards.body: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said India and the U.S. have agreed that Indian goods will get preferential market access in America compared with competitor nations, as announced earlier by President Trump and PM Modi. The first phase framework of the bilateral trade agreement was finalised in February. Both sides aim to close the first tranche by the end of the current financial year.
cards.why_it_matters: Lower U.S. duties than competitors could make Indian exports more competitive, affecting exporters, jobs and India's trade balance.
cards.key_fact: Bilateral trade agreement's first phase framework finalised in February

quiz.q: When was the framework for the first phase of the India-U.S. bilateral trade agreement finalised?
quiz.explain: The article states the framework for the first phase was finalised in February, with the deal later requiring further negotiations.

cards.headline: India, U.S. and eight others sign AI supply chain declaration
cards.body: India, the U.S. and eight other countries signed the San Francisco Declaration at a meeting of the founders of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative. It treats safeguarding AI supply chains as a shared endeavour and proposes five working groups. Pax Silica was launched by the U.S. last December to secure supplies of silicon and other minerals essential to semiconductor and AI production.
cards.why_it_matters: Semiconductors power devices from phones to cars, so secure supply chains matter for India's technology ambitions and economic security.
cards.key_fact: Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S. in December last year

quiz.q: What is the name of the U.S.-led initiative to secure semiconductor and silicon supply chains?
quiz.explain: The article says the Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S. in December last year to secure supply chains for silicon and other minerals.

cards.headline: Wholesale inflation rises to 12.29% year-on-year in October
cards.body: Wholesale inflation quickened to 12.29% year-on-year in October 2026 on higher food and oil prices, government data showed. The print was above the 11.39% rise a month earlier and economists' average forecast of 12.1%. Wholesale food prices rose 8.58%, manufactured products 9.54% and fuel and power 32.84% year-on-year.
cards.why_it_matters: Wholesale price trends signal cost pressures in the economy and can feed into retail inflation, affecting household budgets and interest rate decisions.
cards.key_fact: Wholesale inflation at 12.29% year-on-year in October 2026

quiz.q: What was the year-on-year wholesale inflation rate in October 2026?
quiz.explain: Government data showed wholesale inflation rose to 12.29% year-on-year in October, higher than 11.39% a month earlier.

cards.headline: Government health spending triples to ₹4.14 lakh crore in a decade
cards.body: National Health Accounts estimates show the Union government's health expenditure rose from ₹1.30 lakh crore in 2013-14 to ₹4.14 lakh crore in 2023-24. Out-of-pocket spending by households fell from 64.2% to 42.7% of total health expenditure over the same period. Per capita government health spending nearly tripled, from ₹1,042 to ₹2,959.
cards.why_it_matters: Lower out-of-pocket spending means households bear a smaller share of medical bills, a key measure of financial protection in healthcare.
cards.key_fact: Out-of-pocket health spending fell from 64.2% to 42.7% of total

quiz.q: According to the NHA estimates, what was the share of out-of-pocket health spending in 2023-24?
quiz.explain: Out-of-pocket spending fell from 64.2% in 2013-14 to 42.7% in 2023-24.

cards.headline: Odisha orders early evacuation as third cyclone in three weeks nears
cards.body: The Odisha government directed southern districts to begin evacuating vulnerable areas as a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal intensified. It is expected to become a very severe cyclonic storm and reach the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19 night. Ganjam district, which saw landslide deaths during Cyclone Arnab, is focusing on preventing casualties.
cards.why_it_matters: Early evacuation is a key disaster-preparedness step in coastal Odisha, which faces repeated cyclones each season.
cards.key_fact: Cyclone expected to reach Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19

quiz.q: Around which date is the approaching cyclone expected to reach the Andhra Pradesh coast?
quiz.explain: Officials said the system is likely to reach the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19 night.

cards.headline: Bay of Bengal depression to become Cyclone Akvan, headed to Andhra coast
cards.body: The India Meteorological Department said a depression over the Bay of Bengal is likely to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm by November 17. Named Cyclone Akvan, it is expected to move towards the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19. Rain is forecast for north coastal Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal.
cards.why_it_matters: Cyclone warnings help coastal states and fishing communities prepare for heavy rain, rough seas and possible damage.
cards.key_fact: Cyclone Akvan, expected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm

quiz.q: What is the name given to the approaching cyclonic storm?
quiz.explain: The IMD named the system Cyclone Akvan, a name contributed by Iran.

cards.headline: Andhra, Odisha on alert as Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal
cards.body: The IMD said a well-marked low pressure intensified into a depression in the Bay of Bengal and is expected to become a severe cyclonic storm by November 17, then a very severe cyclonic storm named Cyclone Akvan heading towards the Andhra Pradesh coast. Wind speeds may reach 120-130 kmph, gusting to 145 kmph. Fishing activity has been suspended.
cards.why_it_matters: Cyclone alerts allow authorities to suspend fishing, move people and protect crops and infrastructure ahead of landfall.
cards.key_fact: Cyclone Akvan wind speeds may reach 120-130 kmph, gusting to 145 kmph

quiz.q: What maximum sustained wind speed has the IMD forecast for the approaching system?
quiz.explain: The IMD said maximum sustained surface wind speeds may reach 120-130 kmph, gusting up to 145 kmph.

cards.headline: India votes against UNGA resolution on death penalty moratorium
cards.body: India voted against a UN General Assembly resolution introduced by Mexico calling on nations to establish a moratorium on the death penalty. The 193-member body adopted the resolution by recorded vote, with 133 in favour, 33 against and 16 abstentions. India was joined in opposing it by China, Pakistan, the U.S. and several others.
cards.why_it_matters: The vote reflects India's position that countries should decide their own legal penalties, including capital punishment, under their own laws.
cards.key_fact: 133 countries voted in favour, 33 against, 16 abstained

quiz.q: How many countries voted in favour of the UNGA resolution on a death penalty moratorium?
quiz.explain: The resolution was adopted with 133 votes in favour, 33 against and 16 abstentions.

cards.headline: Jay Shah reappointed unopposed as ICC Chairman for second term
cards.body: The International Cricket Council (ICC) announced on Monday, November 16, 2026, that Jay Shah has been reappointed unopposed as its Chairman for a second two-year term. Shah, 38, took over in December 2024 after serving as BCCI secretary. The ICC said the decision ensures continuity as cricket prepares for its return to the Olympics at the 2028 Los Angeles Games.
cards.why_it_matters: The ICC chairman leads the global governing body of cricket, a sport followed by millions in India, and the reappointment ensures continuity as cricket returns to the Olympics.
cards.key_fact: Jay Shah reappointed ICC Chairman for second two-year term

quiz.q: Who has been reappointed as ICC Chairman for a second term?
quiz.explain: The article states that Jay Shah was reappointed unopposed as ICC Chairman for a second two-year term.

cards.headline: India beat New Zealand by 22 runs in fifth ODI, clinch series 3-1
cards.body: India defeated New Zealand by 22 runs in the fifth and final ODI at Mount Maunganui on Sunday, November 15, 2026, to win the series 3-1. Pacers Arshdeep Singh (3/30) and Mohammad Siraj (2/50) helped bowl New Zealand out for 187 after India were all out for 209. The loss ended New Zealand's streak of 11 consecutive home series wins.
cards.why_it_matters: This series win under Shreyas Iyer boosts India's white-ball form and ends New Zealand's long unbeaten home record, significant for cricket fans.
cards.key_fact: India won the ODI series 3-1 against New Zealand

quiz.q: What was the series result of the India-New Zealand ODI series?
quiz.explain: The article states that India bagged the series 3-1 after winning the fifth ODI by 22 runs.

cards.headline: Lakshya Sen wins Kumamoto Masters Japan Open title
cards.body: Lakshya Sen won the Kumamoto Masters Japan Open badminton title on Sunday, November 15, 2026, defeating Japan's Koki Watanabe 13-21, 21-18, 21-14 in the final. The world No. 13 secured his second consecutive BWF Tour title after the Hylo Open. The win earned him 9,200 points, lifting him to sixth in the Race to Finals standings for the BWF World Tour Finals.
cards.why_it_matters: Lakshya Sen's win improves his chances of qualifying for the prestigious BWF World Tour Finals, a major achievement for Indian badminton.
cards.key_fact: Lakshya Sen won Kumamoto Masters Japan Open, his second consecutive title

quiz.q: Which tournament did Lakshya Sen win on November 15, 2026?
quiz.explain: The article reports that Lakshya Sen clinched the Kumamoto Masters Japan crown with a win over Koki Watanabe.

cards.headline: SpaceX catches Starship in first-ever spaceship 'catch'
cards.body: SpaceX successfully caught its Starship spacecraft with the launch tower's mechanical arms after a test flight from Starbase, Texas, on Saturday, November 14, 2026. The feat, a first for a spaceship, advances fully reusable rocket technology. The 15th test flight saw Starship orbit Earth 14 times and deploy 26 Starlink satellites. SpaceX had previously caught returning booster rockets three times.
cards.why_it_matters: Reusable rockets could drastically lower the cost of space missions, making space more accessible and enabling frequent launches, a significant leap for space technology.
cards.key_fact: SpaceX caught a Starship spacecraft for the first time

quiz.q: What did SpaceX achieve for the first time with its Starship spacecraft?
options: Caught it with the launch tower
Reused it for a second flight
quiz.explain: The article states that SpaceX pulled off the first-ever catch of a spaceship using the launch tower's mechanical arms.

cards.headline: Voyager 1 to become first object one light-day from Earth
cards.body: NASA's Voyager 1 is set to become the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at over 26 billion kilometres. Its radio signals will take exactly 24 hours to reach Earth. Launched 49 years ago, Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in 2012. NASA has invited people to shine Morse code V-G-R after sunset on November 17 to celebrate.
cards.why_it_matters: This milestone highlights the immense scale of space and the longevity of Voyager 1, which continues to send back data from interstellar space, expanding our understanding of the cosmos.
cards.key_fact: Voyager 1 will be one light-day (24 light-hours) from Earth

quiz.q: How long will Voyager 1's radio signals take to reach Earth when it is one light-day away?
quiz.explain: One light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, so signals will take exactly one day to reach Earth.

cards.headline: China confirms first Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral summit in Shenzhen
cards.body: China's Foreign Ministry said President Xi Jinping will meet U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026, for their first trilateral summit. The meeting is expected on the sidelines of the APEC leaders' summit. Trump is expected to raise nuclear arsenal reduction and the war in Iran, but not Russia's war in Ukraine.
cards.why_it_matters: A first-of-its-kind meeting among the leaders of the world's three major nuclear powers could shape global security and diplomacy.
cards.key_fact: First China-Russia-U.S. trilateral summit, Shenzhen, November 19, 2026

quiz.q: Where will the first trilateral summit between Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin be held?
quiz.explain: China's Foreign Ministry said the meeting will take place in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026.

cards.headline: U.S. must respect India's right to defend itself: Blinken
cards.body: Former U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken said on November 14, 2026, that Washington must respect India's right to defend itself and maintain zero tolerance towards terrorism. Speaking in New Delhi, he described U.S. ties with India as global and with Pakistan as regional. He also called for diplomatic efforts to prevent India-Pakistan escalation.
cards.why_it_matters: The remarks signal continued U.S. emphasis on counter-terrorism and stability between two nuclear-armed neighbours.
cards.key_fact: Blinken: U.S. must respect India's right to defend itself

quiz.q: What did Antony Blinken say the U.S. must respect regarding India?
quiz.explain: Blinken said the U.S. must have a zero-tolerance policy for terrorism and respect India's right to defend itself.

cards.headline: U.S. seeks 24-year prison term for Nikhil Gupta in Pannun plot
cards.body: The U.S. government is seeking a 24-year prison term for Indian national Nikhil Gupta, 55, who pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire and money laundering conspiracy in a plot to kill Sikh separatist leader Gurpatwant Singh Pannun on U.S. soil. Sentencing is on November 20, 2026. His lawyers argued for a 12-year term.
cards.why_it_matters: The case involves allegations of an Indian government employee's involvement in a plot on U.S. soil, with implications for India-U.S. relations.
cards.key_fact: U.S. seeks 293 months (about 24 years) for Nikhil Gupta

quiz.q: How many months' imprisonment is the U.S. government seeking for Nikhil Gupta?
quiz.explain: The U.S. Attorney's submission requested 293 months' imprisonment, which is about 24 years.

cards.headline: Mumbai hosts sixth Earthshot Prize Awards on November 17
cards.body: Mumbai will host the sixth annual Earthshot Prize Awards on November 17, 2026, with Prince William and Catherine attending. Five winners from 15 finalists will each receive £1 million for environmental solutions. India has produced more Earthshot winners and finalists than any other country. The ceremony features celebrities including Sachin Tendulkar and Alia Bhatt.
cards.why_it_matters: The Earthshot Prize highlights India's role in environmental innovation and global efforts to scale climate solutions.
cards.key_fact: Earthshot Prize founded by Prince William in 2020; £1 million per winner

quiz.q: Who founded the Earthshot Prize?
quiz.explain: The Earthshot Prize was founded by Prince William in 2020 to support environmental solutions.

cards.headline: Nations grapple with loss of 1.5°C target at COP31
cards.body: At COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, nations are divided on how to respond after the UN declared in September that crossing the 1.5°C warming threshold is imminent and unavoidable. The world has already warmed about 1.4°C above pre-industrial times. Some countries want to reaffirm 1.5°C as the goal, while others are sceptical or see an opportunity to abandon it.
cards.why_it_matters: The 1.5°C target is central to global climate policy, and how nations respond affects emissions cuts and support for vulnerable countries.
cards.key_fact: World has warmed about 1.4°C above pre-industrial times

quiz.q: According to the article, how much has the world warmed above pre-industrial times?
quiz.explain: The article states the world has already warmed about 1.4°C above pre-industrial times.
